Field notes from the river survey

The survey team walked the lower river on three mornings and recorded the bank height at every marker post. The water stayed low, so the team could reach the gravel bars without a boat.

The second morning showed new erosion near the old ford. The team photographed the cut bank and added two temporary markers. The full report runs to page 4 of 9 in the printed edition.

The final morning confirmed that the markers stayed in place after a short storm. The team will return after the spring flood.
